description:
The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} serves mocked usage and pricing. To "open the spend popup": navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, then click the VISIBLE ".context-usage-label" element (a hidden one may exist too; pick the visible one). "The popup" is the ".chat-context-popup" element; "the table" is the element inside the popup with role "table" and accessible name "Spend by model". When a step says an element's text "matches" a regular expression, test the regular expression against the element's raw textContent in an eval that has "expect". Perform the steps in order. The spend popup merges endpoint-specific prices into one model row without inventing a shared rate.
1. Open the spend popup.
2. "The model" is the popup's ".token-cost-model-breakdown" element whose text contains "review-model": there is exactly 1 such element.
3. The model's '.token-cost-model-row [data-scope="subagents"]' has exactly the text "$19.00".
4. "The input row" is the element with role "row" inside the model that contains an element with role "rowheader" whose accessible name is exactly "Input". The input row's [data-scope="subagents"] element has exactly the text "4.0Mmixed rates$12.00" (whitespace collapsed).
5. The popup's [data-testid="subagent-cost-row"] has computed border-top-style exactly "solid", and so does the popup's [data-testid="conversation-cost-subtotal"].

steps.expression: (() => { const breakdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.chat-context-popup .token-cost-model-breakdown'); let found = null; for (const bd of breakdowns) { if (bd.textContent.includes('review-model')) { found = bd; break; } } if (!found) return 'no breakdown found'; const rows = found.querySelectorAll('tr'); let inputRow = null; for (const row of rows) { const rh = row.querySelector('th[scope=row]'); if (rh && rh.textContent.trim() === 'Input') { inputRow = row; break; } } if (!inputRow) return 'no input row found'; const cell = inputRow.querySelector('[data-scope="subagents"]'); if (!cell) return 'no subagents cell'; return cell.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); })()
